headline: Adani plans bond sales, secures power deals, and expands cement footprint.
summary: Adani Group flagships are targeting ₹2,000 crore via domestic public bonds while securing a major 1,750 MW round-the-clock renewable contract in West Bengal. Meanwhile, Ambuja Cements advances a 30 MTPA expansion and a carbon capture pilot, and Adani Defence negotiates a manufacturing joint venture with Embraer.

stories.what: Adani Enterprises and Adani Power are planning to raise at least ₹2,000 crore ($220 million) through public bond issuances. The companies are currently working with local bond arrangers to execute the offerings.
stories.why: Public bond issues remain rare in India's corporate debt market, which is heavily dominated by private placements. Successfully tapping retail and institutional public bond buyers expands the group's domestic funding sources.

brief.happened: Adani Enterprises Ltd and Adani Power Ltd are preparing to enter the domestic retail and public bond market to raise at least ₹2,000 crore ($220 million). According to reports from Bloomberg and Business Standard on 26 November 2026, the two companies are currently working with local bond arrangers. One of the public offerings is targeted to launch by the end of the current period.
brief.background: Public offerings account for only a small fraction of corporate bond sales in India, as the market relies mostly on private placement deals with institutional investors.
brief.next: The launch of the first public bond offering is targeted by the end of the current cycle.
numbers: ₹2,000 crore ($220 million) target public bond raise
views: Business Standard reports Adani Enterprises and Adani Power are planning a public bond sale.
Bloomberg reports the companies are working with local bond arrangers on the issue.

stories.watch: Launch timeline and pricing of the public bond issues.
stories.title: Adani Enterprises, Adani Power planning public bond sale to raise ₹2,000 cr

stories.what: Adani Energy Solutions subsidiary Powerpulse Trading Solutions won a Letter of Award from WBSEDCL to supply 1,750 MW of round-the-clock renewable power over 25 years. The deal includes a greenshoe option to expand supply by an additional 750 MW.
stories.why: Securing long-term, 25-year round-the-clock power purchase agreements strengthens steady cash flows for the energy transmission and trading arm.

brief.happened: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Powerpulse Trading Solutions Ltd, received a Letter of Award on 21 November 2026 from West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd. The contract mandates supplying 1,750 MW of round-the-clock renewable energy for 25 years starting July 2028. An optional 750 MW greenshoe extension can scale total supply to 2,500 MW starting April 2029.
brief.background: State discoms are increasingly contracting round-the-clock green power to meet baseline demand while fulfilling clean energy mandates.
brief.next: Base supply is scheduled to commence in July 2028, with the greenshoe portion starting April 2029.
views: BW Businessworld reports AESL secured the LOA via Powerpulse Trading Solutions Ltd.

stories.watch: Execution of the power purchase agreement and exercise of the greenshoe option by WBSEDCL.
stories.title: Adani Energy Solutions Secures 1,750 MW Renewable Power Contract From WBSEDCL

stories.what: Ambuja Cements is planning to add ~30 MTPA of cement capacity across India, while partner Calix progresses a carbon capture demonstration project at the Sanghi cement plant in Gujarat.
stories.why: Expanding manufacturing capacity reinforces market leadership in building materials, while testing carbon capture technologies addresses long-term sustainability and emission targets.

brief.happened: Ambuja Cements Limited announced expansion plans to add ~30 MTPA of cement capacity across its East, West, and North clusters, building on its existing 113.5 MTPA capacity across 24 integrated plants and 24 grinding units. Separately, technology partner Calix announced at its AGM on 23 November 2026 that engineering studies are underway for a commercial-scale carbon capture demonstration facility at Ambuja's Sanghi plant in Gujarat.
brief.background: Ambuja Cements is part of the Adani Portfolio and is scaling up its building materials network aggressively across major regional markets in India.
brief.next: Partners aim to make a Go/No-Go decision on the Sanghi carbon capture project during fiscal year 2027.

11.6 MTPA new grinding capacity in East Cluster
2.9 MTPA new grinding capacity in North Cluster

stories.what: Adani Defence & Aerospace and Brazilian manufacturer Embraer are in talks to form a joint venture to manufacture civilian aircraft in India, though shareholding terms remain unresolved.
stories.why: Establishing a domestic civil aircraft manufacturing facility advances the group's aerospace ambitions and supports local manufacturing capabilities.

brief.happened: Adani Defence & Aerospace is negotiating joint venture terms with Brazilian planemaker Embraer to manufacture civilian aircraft in India, according to industry sources reported by BusinessLine on 26 November 2026. Ownership structure is the main point of contention, with Embraer seeking a 51% majority stake to ensure quality control and technology transfer compliance, while Adani desires a 51% stake in its own favor.
brief.background: India is pushing to develop domestic aerospace assembly and manufacturing infrastructure through strategic foreign partnerships.
brief.next: Finalization of equity ownership structure between Adani Defence and Embraer.

stories.what: Adani Power shut down one 800-MW unit at its Godda thermal power plant for scheduled annual maintenance, temporarily halving electricity exports to Bangladesh.
stories.why: Routine maintenance of generation units is necessary for plant reliability, though short-term disruptions impact cross-border power supply arrangements.

brief.happened: Adani Power temporarily shut down one of the two 800-MW units at its Godda power plant in Jharkhand starting midnight on 25 November 2026 for routine annual overhaul. The scheduled maintenance will run until 18 December 2026. The plant's remaining 800-MW unit continues to operate normally, supplying power under agreement to Bangladesh.
brief.background: The Godda power plant consists of two 800-MW thermal units dedicated to exporting electricity to the Bangladesh Power Development Board.
brief.next: The shut-down 800-MW unit is scheduled to resume operation on 18 December 2026.

India Today reports the shutdown temporarily halves supply during ongoing Bangladesh power shortages.

stories.what: Diamond Power Infrastructure secured orders worth ₹488.18 crore (including GST) to supply 6,659.66 km of conductor cables for Adani's Bhadla-Fatehpur HVDC transmission project.
stories.why: Procuring critical transmission line components ensures timely construction of high-voltage corridors linking renewable hubs in Rajasthan to regional demand centers.

brief.happened: Diamond Power Infrastructure received orders valued at ₹488.18 crore (₹413.71 crore excluding GST) to supply AL-59 conductors for Adani's ±800 kV Bhadla-Fatehpur High Voltage Direct Current project. The supply contracts cover 6,659.66 km of conductor wires (5,692.66 km of Lapwing and 967 km of Zebra variants) across Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh segments.
brief.background: The Bhadla-Fatehpur HVDC link is built to transmit large volumes of renewable power from Rajasthan to northern and central Indian grid infrastructure.
brief.next: Monthly deliveries are scheduled for completion by 31 December 2027.

₹413.71 crore base order value excluding GST

stories.what: The Supreme Court of India issued a notice to the Central Government regarding an appeal by an Adani-backed duty-free retailer against a High Court order on Mumbai airport sales.
stories.why: Clarifies legal and regulatory boundaries for retail and duty-free operations at major airport hubs managed by Adani Airports.

brief.happened: The Supreme Court of India issued a notice to the Union Government on 25 November 2026 following a petition filed by an Adani-backed duty-free retailer. The plea challenges a Bombay High Court ruling which held that duty-free operations at Mumbai airport selling nicotine pouches are not exempt from Indian domestic regulatory laws.

The acquisition of the European liquid storage platform was pursued via a competitive global auction from sellers F.S. Amelia S.à r.l. and Evos Manco B.V.
brief.background: APSEZ has been expanding its international logistics network through strategic port and terminal acquisitions across key trade corridors.
brief.next: Completion of regulatory approvals and closing procedures for the Evos acquisition.

concept.explain: A greenshoe option is a clause in a supply or underwriting contract that allows the buyer or underwriter to purchase additional goods or shares beyond the initial agreed quantity at the set contract price. In today's news, West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd holds an option to purchase an additional 750 MW of power from Adani Energy Solutions beyond the primary 1,750 MW commitment. This provides flexibility to scale volume without re-tendering.

question.q: Why would Adani Enterprises and Adani Power look to raise ₹2,000 crore via public corporate bonds rather than standard private placements?
question.a: While Indian corporate debt is heavily reliant on institutional private placements, launching public bond issues allows the group to diversify its lender base toward retail and high-net-worth investors. It helps build a deeper domestic retail debt market presence, lowers concentration risk among institutional lenders, and establishes public benchmarks for future corporate debt issuances.

headline: Adani Portfolio Advances Debt, Capacity Expansion, and International Logistics Deals

BigMint and World Cement report that the expansion includes grinding capacities of ~15.5 MTPA in the West Cluster, 11.6 MTPA in the East Cluster, and 2.9 MTPA in the North Cluster. Separately, Australia-based Calix stated at its AGM that it is progressing its partnership with Ambuja Cements to develop a commercial-scale carbon capture demonstration project at the Sanghi cement plant in Gujarat.

stories.what: Adani Enterprises signed a three-year copper supply agreement with Attero to procure 2,000 tonnes monthly of copper anodes for its Kutch Copper facility in Mundra.
stories.why: Securing domestic recycled feedstock reduces dependence on imported concentrates amid global supply tightness and supports sustainable sourcing.

brief.happened: Adani Enterprises reportedly signed a three-year copper supply agreement with Noida-based recycler Attero to procure copper anodes for its Kutch Copper facility in Mundra, Gujarat. BigMint reports that Attero will supply 2,000 tonnes monthly, totaling 24,000 tonnes annually and 72,000 tonnes over three years. Sources estimate the deal value at around $1 billion. The arrangement aims to reduce Adani's imported feedstock dependence by approximately 5%, as Attero recovers copper from electronic waste and discarded batteries.
brief.background: Adani entered India's copper industry in March 2024 by commissioning the Kutch Copper facility, operating against a backdrop of persistent tightness in global copper concentrate availability.
brief.next: Ongoing monthly deliveries from Attero to the Kutch Copper refinery.

Adani Power stated that the shutdown was scheduled in advance in coordination with the Bangladesh Power Development Board, which granted clearance for the maintenance on October 26.

concept.explain: High Voltage Direct Current systems are used for efficient bulk power transmission over very long distances with lower electrical losses compared to alternating current lines. Today's news highlights orders for AL-59 conductors destined for the major Bhadla-Fatehpur HVDC corridor, which facilitates the evacuation of large blocks of power across northern and central India. For infrastructure managers, understanding HVDC logistics and conductor specifications is crucial for managing supply chain bottlenecks in major transmission projects.

question.q: With Adani Power undertaking a 25-day overhaul at the Godda plant while simultaneously planning public bond issuances with Adani Enterprises, how do scheduled plant maintenance cycles intersect with corporate capital raising strategies?
question.a: Scheduled maintenance temporarily reduces output and near-term cash generation from specific operating assets like Godda, making predictable cash flow management essential. Concurrently, tapping public bond markets diversifies debt instruments to maintain strong liquidity buffers across group entities, ensuring that operational downtime in one unit does not impair broader financial stability.

concept.explain: Non-aeronautical revenue refers to income generated by airport operators from non-flight activities such as retail leases, duty-free shopping, parking fees, advertising, and city-side real estate development like hotels. Unlike regulated aeronautical tariffs charged to airlines, non-aero income yields significantly higher margins and is less sensitive to flight volume fluctuations. Building out robust non-aero infrastructure, as seen in Adani Airports' latest $300 million fundraise, optimizes land utilization and boosts overall airport equity valuations.

question.q: Why is Adani Airports diluting equity at the subsidiary level to fund non-aeronautical infrastructure instead of relying purely on debt?
question.a: Raising primary equity from strategic investors like 360 ONE Asset keeps leverage ratios manageable while capital-intensive city-side real estate projects are under construction. Non-aeronautical assets like hotels and retail hubs have longer gestation periods before cash flow generation, making low-cost equity funding safer for balance sheet health than loading debt onto the parent company.
